titel: Why Your Bunny Shouldn't Live With A Guinea Pig

beats.say: Why should your bunny never live... with a *guinea pig?*
Rudi's bunny looks *lonely.* So Rudi buys it a tiny friend!
They don't get along, so Rudi buys a *bigger* hutch. The bunny zooms, and kicks its roommate.
Next, Rudi becomes the *referee.* The guinea pig just... sneezes.
Rabbits and guinea pigs don't *speak* the same language.
And a rabbit's strong back legs can easily *hurt* a guinea pig.
Rabbits can also carry a *germ.* It's the top cause of breathing illness in guinea pigs.
And guinea pigs can't make their own *vitamin C.* Rabbits can.
Instead, a bunny needs a *bunny* friend. And a guinea pig needs a guinea pig.
So before you buy your bunny a tiny friend... ask yourself:
